description: CICCHINI / State Senate / ENOUGH (Official political campaign car magnet of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) The logo that launched a historic campaign for State Senate in Michigan. Independents embrace ALL colors on the spectrum, and this car magnet reflects the commitment to include and represent everyone. A bold, weather-ready car magnet that turns your support for Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate into a clear statement on the road. Printed on white vinyl with a matte finish and a strong black magnetic backing, this rectangular magnet holds fast to steel surfaces while resisting rain, sun, and everyday wear. The digital-direct print keeps colors vibrant — note that a white base may show through darker elements. It’s made in the USA from globally sourced materials and built to last. Product features - 100% vinyl face with matte finish - All-weather durability for outdoor use - Black magnetic backing for secure attachment - Digital-direct (DDP) print for vivid color - Available in three sizes; made in the USA Care instructions - Wipe the dust off gently with a soft, dry cloth. Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
